# Qwen Token Plan usage for DeepSeek Harness
> **Superseded.** This plugin has been merged into dsh-coding-plan-usage, which shows Qwen Token Pla
n, Z.ai GLM Coding Plan, and MiniMax Coding Plan usage in one place and migrates your existing Qwen
sign-in automatically. New installs should use that repository.
Show your Qwen Cloud Token Plan usage in DeepSeek Harness. The card appears at the bottom of **Setti
Cloud Token Plan usage in DeepSeek Harness. The card appears at the bottom of **Settings → Models**.
The inference API key cannot read plan quota. Sign-in opens a dedicated Edge or Chrome window, not y
our everyday browser. After you sign in, the plugin reads only `qwencloud.com` cookies and shows the
quota Qwen actually returns: monthly, 5-hour, and weekly figures appear only when that field is pre
a Qwen actually returns: monthly, 5-hour, and weekly figures appear only when that field is present.
This is an unofficial plugin. It is not affiliated with Alibaba, Qwen, or DeepSeek. The usage endpoi
nts are undocumented console APIs and can change.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1` or later, with a Web UI profile.
- Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome.
- A Q
wen Cloud account with a Token Plan. An inference API key alone is not enough.
Verified on DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2` / `0.2.1-rc.3` and Windows Edge.
## Privacy
The sign-in profile lives in `~/.dsh/qwen-plan-usage/edge-profile`. Do not share that folder. The de
bugger listens only on `127.0.0.1` while the window is open. Cookies are stored in the DSH credentia
l record `qwen-plan-usage/session` and are not shown again. Sign-out deletes that record and does no
t delete your inference API key.
See SECURITY.md.
